headline: Arsenal's Mikel Arteta downplays Bruno Guimarães injury
description: Mikel Arteta has played down the severity of Bruno Guimarães' groin problem after the midfielder missed Arsenal's 3-0 win over Coventry City on Friday.

headline: Arsenal rout Coventry in 'perfect start' to Premier League title defense
description: Arsenal made light work of Premier League newcomers Coventry City as the Gunners began their title defense with a statement 3-0 win at the Emirates Stadium on Friday.

headline: Leboeuf: Arsenal have 'no other contenders' after opening win vs. Coventry
description: Leboeuf: Arsenal have 'no other contenders' after opening win vs. Coventry

headline: Premier League recap: Arsenal kick off season with win over Coventry
description: The 2026-27 Premier League season kicked off with defending champions Arsenal beating newly promoted Coventry City 3-0 at the Emirates.

headline: Watch out, Premier League -- Arsenal are still the team to beat
description: Arsenal more than looked the part of reigning champions, strolling past Coventry to kick off the Premier League season.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United looking at move for Barça's Balde
description: Manchester United are looking into the possibility of signing defender Alejandro Balde from Barcelona. Transfer Talk has the latest.
